scope: Independent exact caption-only replacement encoded review. Historical REWORK records preserved; human soundwatch, Apple-native playback and publication remain separate.

lessons.reason: The caption-only replacement resolves EMBED-ENC-02. Exact movie, all395registered artifacts and four live/frozen source pairs are verified. The complete delivered narration is byte-identical; the sole source conditional reverses exactly to the archived rejected source. Twenty-six prior personally viewed registered images match exactly; the changed closing sheet, four changed registered natives and five changed exact MP4 extractions were personally inspected. Six other extracted PNGs match prior personal views. The prediction stays neutral before the score clause completes; comparison text accompanies disclosed scores and query rotation; both winners remain held until their completed clauses. The prior GloVe weight repair remains exact. Count/PPMI, optimizer, masks, weighted vectors and basis-alignment mechanisms are strong; several secondary passages retain long settled plots.
